name: GoldReserve profit claim keyed on current NFT balance
summary: GoldReserve records claimed profit per address while entitlement is computed from the caller's current ERC1155 balance, so the attacker minted NFTs after a profit deposit and moved the same NFTs through fresh addresses to claim the same profit repeatedly.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.
